title: VNP eGlobal Shipping
subtitle: Per-factory ship-from (ShippingFrom) addresses — orders ship from the address assigned to their factory. Multiple factories can share one address. Config lives per environment: on production just create/assign right on this page.
notConfigured: VNP eGlobal not configured — missing env: {{missing}}. Fill the API .env and restart.
